name: Constraint Injection
description: Inserts a constraint verification node into the pipeline that enforces decorrelation, fairness, or physics-invariance. Predictions must satisfy a statistical test (KS, CvM, etc.) against a protected variable. Two strategies: training-time (modify loss function) or post-hoc (noise injection).

inserted_nodes.name: verify_constraint
inserted_nodes.description: Test whether predictions are statistically independent of the protected variable. If the test fails, apply a decorrelation strategy.

inserted_nodes.name: apply_decorrelation
inserted_nodes.description: If the constraint test fails, apply decorrelation. Options: noise injection (post-hoc, trades accuracy for constraint satisfaction) or retrain with flatness loss (training-time, modifies the gradient).

notes: The Flavours of Physics competition demonstrated that noise injection on a powerful full-feature model (AUC 0.982 → 0.881 after noise) beats a feature-restricted model (AUC 0.834). The constraint injection expansion formalizes this insight.
